title: Homological Aspects of Separable Extensions of Triangulated Categories
summary: We investigate the homological behaviour of compactly generated triangulated categories under separable extensions. We show that homological invariants (finiteness of global dimension, gorensteinness and regularity) are preserved under such extensions. We also establish a relation between singularity categories in this setting, proving that the singularity category of a separable extension is equivalent, up to retracts, to a separable extension of the singularity category.
